_readme: Per-sheet tuning for scripts/slice-sprite.py. 'erode' is how many px of ink are shaved off before the gaps are measured — higher clears more spray specks and drips out of the aisles, lower keeps pieces that sit close together apart. 'split_x'/'split_y' force a cut through a cell the projection could not find, 'merge' joins two cells, 'drop' removes one.

66CFA744-5588-4B11-8099-2EBBA9051E28._note: the dashed trail's segments read as two cells and are merged back; the controller sits on the lamp post's glow with no aisle between them, so that cell is cut by hand at the thinnest row

9E31BFFF-A9D8-42AF-8948-B9F70AB4D4CB._note: the books and the pizza box overlap in the render; there is no aisle to find, so both are placed by hand

D251958E-3EEF-4E72-ADAB-EA5D00186762._note: 6 keeps each '!' joined to its dot; the scribble's two loops read as separate cells, so they are merged back, as are the two exclamation marks into one '!!'
